title: Evolve recipe candidates from traces under registry and safety gates
narrative: A candidate evolution loop collects immutable traces, proposes registry-bounded recipe configurations or compositions, validates connectivity and budgets, evaluates in isolation, selects by multi-objective policy, then promotes only after gates. Generic research loops exist (`taloneth_atk_research_reject`); recipe-from-traces does not. Tracks MH-SR-06[^insp-sr-06].
implementation: ResearchLab, harness experiments, evaluator, ObjectivePolicy, decision-plane shadow. Desired: traces→recipe-candidate proposer wired to registry validation and promotion.
validation: Kind `inspiration_delta_contract`. Soft expects requirement_id MH-SR-06, coverage partial, adjacent_ok, probes_ok with typed surface probes encoding the current product delta.
